summary: Forest Service two-story lookout on Indian Mountain, Adams County, Idaho: CCC-built 1933, staffed until 2015 per NRHP nomination, NRHP-listed 2022, drive-up.

facts.status_note: Standing but automated and unstaffed since 2015 per the NRHP nomination; a 2021 Idaho Fire Lookouts post still says staffed.

access.note: Drive-up at the end of National Forest Road 243; still an active Forest Service fire-detection site. No rental or public visiting arrangement found in the sources read.

visit.trail_note: No trail described in the sources read; reached by road.

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service (Payette National Forest, Council Ranger District)

events.note: Site first used for fire detection, with a tent camp.
Log cupola cabin built on the site; replaced by the 1933 lookout.
Present two-story lookout built by Civilian Conservation Corps enrollees to a modified Forest Service plan.
Andy Clelland listed as a lookout.
Restored to original specifications in 1993-94 (NHLR); roof shingles installed in 1993 (NRHP nomination).
Registered with the National Historic Lookout Register on March 1, 1998.
NRHP nomination says staffed fire lookout activity ended in 2015 and the tower is now automated. A 2021 Idaho Fire Lookouts post says it is staffed.
Forest Service replaced the stairs, catwalk and railings it found unsafe; railings raised to meet current building codes.
National Register of Historic Places listing; start date 11 August 2022 per Wikidata.

corrections.why: The record uses NHLR's 7,136 ft (2,175 m). The NRHP nomination and Wikidata give 7,255 ft, and Idaho Fire Lookouts and firelookout.com give 7253 ft, which is about 2,211 m.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho Fire Lookouts (2021) says staffed for fire detection and firelookout.com says staffed in summer until recently; the NRHP nomination says staffed activity ended in 2015 and the tower is now automated. Facts and story follow the nomination as the most detailed dated account, and flag the disagreement.
NHLR and firelookout.com call it an L-4 (R1/L4) design; the NRHP nomination calls the cab R4 Plan 80 under an Intermountain Region standard. Facts keep L-4 and do not reconcile the names further.
NHLR and Idaho Fire Lookouts give a 14 by 14 ft cab; the NRHP nomination gives 14 ft 6 in square. Not used in the story.
NHLR gives 7,136 ft; Idaho Fire Lookouts and firelookout.com give 7253 ft; NRHP nomination and Wikidata give 7,255 ft. The story gives the NRHP figure and states the NHLR figure beside it.

sources.title: Indian Mountain Fire Lookout, National Register of Historic Places nomination (NPS Form 10-900)

notes_for_editor: Staffing status conflicts across sources; the 2015 end date rests on the NRHP nomination alone. The nomination PDF was read by grep excerpts, not in full. Access 'restricted' is a judgement from drive-up plus an active Forest Service detection site; no visitor policy was found. Do not confuse with the Washington Indian Mountain Lookout (nhlr.org/lookouts/us/wa/indian-mountain-lookout/), a separate tower with a 1953 replacement. Idaho Fire Lookouts' known-staff list is partial and was not used beyond 1942. No photos with a verified URL and licence were found. Fact-check 2026-10-08: the West Mountains line now describes the view from the lookout, not its location; the 2021 staffing post is dated in the story; the off-limits advice was replaced with a sourced statement.
